title: 小型の振動タンピングランマー
description: 狭い溝や道路補修現場の転圧作業を表す縦型ランマー。矩形の足、伸縮脚、蛇腹カバー、駆動ケース、エンジンと防振ハンドルを備えます。プレート転圧機とは異なる狭所用機器の静的形状です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.460 × 1.171 × 0.480 m、26,308三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A vertical tamping rammer for narrow trench and road-repair scenes, with a rectangular shoe, telescopic leg, protective bellows, gearbox, engine and isolated handle. This is a narrow-area tamping machine, functionally distinct from a plate compactor; no operational motion is included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.460 × 1.171 × 0.480 m; 26,308 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
